capabilities: Mark a note read or done with a one-click footer toggle button
Gray out finished notes and add a checkmark in the file explorer
Expose frontmatter properties as data-link attributes on explorer items for CSS snippets
Configure which properties are exposed and which get footer toggles
Reuse or edit the built-in list of status property names (done, finished, complete, archived)
extras: The catalog listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Only markdown files are decorated, and the plugin cleans up attributes when properties are removed from settings or the plugin is disabled.
intentEvidence: Supercharged Links repaints the explorer only when its DOM is rebuilt, so it can show stale values
problem: Note status lives in frontmatter properties, but the file explorer hides it and marking a note done means scrolling back to the properties panel.

relations.evidence: The attribute format is identical to Supercharged Links, so CSS snippets written for it keep working unchanged.

summary: Marks notes read or done with a footer button and styles file-explorer entries from frontmatter properties via built-in graying or custom CSS.
